-- Georgia: Ossoff confirmed D, R runoff (Collins vs Dooley) June 16 — set candidate2 to NULL for TBD display
UPDATE senate_races
SET candidate2_name = NULL,
    candidate2_party = NULL,
    candidate2_vote_pct = NULL,
    notes = 'R primary runoff June 16: Mike Collins (incumbent Rep.) vs. Derek Dooley (former UT football coach). Winner faces incumbent Sen. Jon Ossoff (D) in November. Rated Lean D.'
WHERE state_code = 'GA';

-- Texas: Talarico confirmed D, R runoff (Cornyn vs Paxton) May 26 — set candidate2 to NULL for TBD display
UPDATE senate_races
SET candidate2_name = NULL,
    candidate2_party = NULL,
    candidate2_vote_pct = NULL,
    primary_runoff_date = 'May 26, 2026',
    notes = 'R primary runoff May 26: John Cornyn (incumbent) vs. Ken Paxton (TX AG, Trump-endorsed). Winner faces Democrat James Talarico in November. Cook: Lean R if Cornyn wins, Toss-up if Paxton wins.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX';

-- Louisiana: Both parties have runoffs June 27 — show leading candidates from each party's runoff
UPDATE senate_races
SET candidate1_name = 'Jamie Davis',
    candidate1_party = 'D',
    candidate1_vote_pct = 47.00,
    candidate2_name = 'Julia Letlow',
    candidate2_party = 'R',
    candidate2_vote_pct = 45.00,
    primary_runoff_date = 'June 27, 2026',
    notes = 'Both parties in runoff June 27. GOP: Julia Letlow (45%) vs. John Fleming (28%) — incumbent Cassidy eliminated with 25%. Dem: Jamie Davis (47%) vs. Gary Crockett. GOP runoff winner heavily favored in November.'
WHERE state_code = 'LA';
